d: A shocking threat has reportedly been issued against Bollywood megastar Amitabh Bachchan and his son Abhishek Bachchan by gangster Goldy Dhillon. The threatening message allegedly contains a chilling warning that the father-son duo will be attacked even if they are travelling in bulletproof vehicles. What exactly did the message say? How was the threat delivered, and what steps are the authorities taking in response? The incident has raised serious concerns about the security of the Bachchan family and sparked questions about the gangster's intentions. Watch this report for all the details…
